changes: Jazzy lifecycle declare/get compatibility; private namespace; no new nav2_core ABI
existing complete rotation run constraint correction retained
failed per-pose TF transform now throws instead of using default pose
Guard bounded closest-point iterator before decrementing twice
RPP observation uses exact pre-compute segment; stateful, reverse and fixed curvature disabled
Actual measured odometry uses receive-time and original header freshness gates
Filled body sweep at actual origin covers whole remaining signed rotation and predicted constant-twist arc
Jazzy FeasibleGoalChecker binds to per-node/controller generation and current ordered remaining-path state; installed SimpleGoalChecker still checks exact final goal with stateful=false
TF actual body and path transformation chains check ROS age, future/regressed stamps and steady stamp-progress age
Installed official raw path first primitive sample is joined to actual start with bounded forward connector plus checked heading alignment; proven float round-trip is restored independently per axis
Sparse FollowPath input is subdivided along its existing line/yaw geometry to <=1cm and <=0.02rad; original final goal retained
Both controller routes share resolution-adaptive filled constant-twist commandSweepFree; this is not physical braking or leg-motion acceptance

CheckedHybrid is an explicit DUBIN control group using installed SmacPlannerHybrid, with the same filled path/final-goal guards; its curved first sample does not use the stop-turn lateral alignment contract

Default-off paired Lattice goal-cell binding proves native or float-emitted goal-cell endpoints, retains exact original server goal, and separates the optional terminal position region from the executable raw prefix

Opt-in active nonterminal and final rotations use monotonic absolute heading checkpoints, with actual-origin full remaining rotation sweeps; RPP never tracks an artificial quantization tail and external goal tolerances are unchanged
Numerical co-location applies to the whole run about its first anchor, preventing tiny translated samples from disguising a curved loop as an in-place rotation

Opt-in GoalChecker rechecks latest real body TF directly in the immutable original-goal frame with original tolerances and freshness limits, then atomically revalidates the plan/cycle binding; reset-after-setPlan preserves the new goal while clearing completion
scope: Experimental compatibility adapter; not native rolling Nav2 ControllerServer
